note: Every text-on-background pair the tokens define. `text` and `background` are token names from tokens.css; `min` is 4.5 for text and 3 for large text and interface parts (icons, the focus ring). tokens.test.ts computes each ratio.

pairs.use: text on a soft surface (segmented control, chips)
secondary text on a soft surface (rest day icon, notes)
text on the primary button and a selected day
text on the primary button while hovered
accent colored text and links on a card
safety note and failure notice text
field error text on a card
field error text on the page
